main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The union between science and spirituality
header_desc: Human beings harbor a free will of perception connected to the cosmos. Our left hemisphere —the psyche— is tied to the temporal and material, while the right —the pneuma— opens to the timeless and divine.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Realm of Light
left_body: This knowledge seeks to show humanity that Jesus of Nazareth possessed a condition known as Primordial Consciousness, demonstrating that human existence transcends both matter and space-time. The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠. This grants us a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE | EGO⟩. In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the material-temporal illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to transcend that curvature and return to the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos, in the purity of the pneuma ❤️. In this light, the statement "the Father and I are one" is a call to dissolve the "false self" to return to the realm of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (La Patria Grande).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: A journey through gnosis and physics
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call to balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why the laws of Newton and Maxwell do not distinguish between past and future, the rupture of simultaneity by Einstein, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual ensemble Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as the imprisonment of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas, but to liberate the inner spark from the demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Realm of Light and The Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth—also known as the great architect of matter—is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. Meanwhile, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox comes down to this: in the immensity of the cosmos—with its more than two trillion galaxies—that is where Jesus' phrase resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one.” Could this have had a hidden message about the deep connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a large, white man with a fiery beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the sum of the physical laws governing the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
